Bite-size chicken thigh marinated in soy and five spice, coated in sweet potato flour, fried crisp and tossed with fried basil and chilli salt. Cut 600g chicken thigh into bite-size pieces and marinate 30 minutes with 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp five spice, 2 grated garlic cloves and 1 tsp sugar. Toss in 100g sweet potato flour or cornflour. Fry at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp, then drain. Fry a handful of basil leaves for 10 seconds. Mix 1 tsp salt, half a teaspoon white pepper and half a teaspoon chilli powder and toss through the chicken and basil. Serve in paper bags.

M: dinner at the Lee family table
Chicken thighs braised in soy, ginger, star anise and a little sugar for 40 minutes until glossy, with steamed rice and garlic bok choy.

Beef strips seared hot in a wok, broccoli and garlic tossed through, finished with oyster sauce and served over egg noodles. Slice 500g rump steak thinly and toss with 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp oil. Blanch 1 large head broccoli in florets for 1 minute and drain. Loosen 400g fresh egg noodles in hot water. Sear the beef in a smoking wok in 2 batches for 1 minute each and set aside. Stir-fry 3 garlic cloves and 1 tbsp ginger for 30 seconds, add the broccoli, beef, 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp soy and 60ml water and toss. Serve over the noodles.

s.note: Mei's dad cooking in the family kitchen
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with shredded wombok, grated ginger, sliced spring onion and salt. Fill dumpling wrappers and pleat. Fry in oil until crisp underneath, add a splash of water, cover and steam 5 minutes. Serve with black vinegar.

s.note: the family temple Mei helps look after
s.how: Take 12 frozen bao buns and gently open each one. Spoon in a teaspoon of sweet red bean paste and pinch the edges closed. Steam in a lined basket for 12 minutes until soft and puffy. Serve warm in the basket.

m.note: dinner at the Lee family table
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs, then add 125ml soy sauce, 250ml water, sliced ginger, 2 star anise and a spoon of sugar. Braise 40 minutes until glossy. Serve over jasmine rice with bok choy stir-fried with garlic.

w.how: Blend 2 mangoes into a puree and warm with 80g sugar. Soak 4 gelatine sheets, squeeze and stir in until dissolved. Stir in 250ml evaporated milk. Pour into glasses and chill for 4 hours. Top with diced fresh mango.

d.note: Mei, Miriam, Priya and Abby hanging out
d.how: Cook tapioca pearls as the packet says and soak in syrup of brown sugar and water. Brew 4 strong black tea bags in 500ml water and cool. Spoon pearls into glasses, add ice, pour over the tea and top with milk. Serve with wide straws.
